parts.answer: For patients with moderate renal impairment in Germany, the eGFR category is 30-59. The approved German renal starting dose for AX-17 is 25 mg once daily, with a maximum dose of 50 mg/day. Monitoring for this category involves rechecking in 2-4 weeks. Regarding hepatic monitoring, baseline hepatic laboratory values are required, with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21.
